name: antifragile-harness
description: EU AI Act (Regulation 2024/1689) and Digital Omnibus (Regulation 2026/1744) compliance harness for Claude Code and MCP clients. 24 deterministic analyzers (including MCP toolchain & Claude Code security + AST-gated Art. 50), 60-second Founder/Startup quickstart (/ai-act-quickstart), diff-aware security review (/ai-act-security-review) interoperating with claude-security@claude-plugins-official, Claude Compliance API & SARIF 2.1.0, interactive visual context graph (/ai-act-graph), cryptographic release dossier (/ai-act-dossier), 12-framework projection (/ai-act-cross-framework including EN 18286:2026), and autonomous startup/regulatory remediation (/ai-act-scan-fix).
author: Andrei Bacu (@Peaky8linders)

install.claude-code: /plugin marketplace add Peaky8linders/antifragile-harness, then /plugin install antifragile-harness@antifragile-harness
install.note: The plugin starts its bundled engine with uvx (uv fetches Python and the dependencies on first start), so there is no separate engine install. There is no PyPI package; the pre-rename `eu-ai-act-scanner` name there is an unrelated third-party project.
